holdout: Domestic holdout: Eredivisie, Primeira Liga and Super Lig, 16 Jan - 10 Oct 2026 (646 matches, 25 weeks), Bet365 pre-match prices with the margin removed; evaluation_harness.py --declaration, recorded in evaluation/holdout_ledger.json
candidate_definition: C8 exactly as registered in PR #183 and left unchanged by PR #185 (harness candidate C8, research_rate_calibration.py): the fold's Dixon-Coles goal rates without the last-ten form term, through the rate calibration with the Elo term (a_home, a_away, b, c), on C2's (rho, delta) grid refitted on C8's own rates; both fits walk-forward on matches forecast and played before each 14-day fold origin, pooled across the 8 leagues. No slope on top, no penalty or carry-over variant. Reads no odds.
measures: Baseline minus candidate log loss (C6 minus C8; positive = C8 better) on AH settlement across all lines (primary) and on the draw-sensitive lines (-0.5, 0, +0.5), on the holdout fixtures both forecast, whole calendar weeks resampled, 95% interval. Calibration rule v3 (v2 with the relative slope rule) on C8's holdout 1X2 forecasts: each of the home and away slopes is in 0.90-1.10 or closer to 1 than C6's on the same fixtures, and no outcome band of at least 30 matches is more than 5 points off AND Bonferroni-clear.

proven.conditions: The sample minimum is met, the calibration rule passes, C6 minus C8 on AH all lines is positive with its 95% interval clear of zero, and the point estimate on the draw-sensitive lines is positive.

release_with_guardrails.conditions: Not proven (the AH all interval includes zero), but the sample minimum is met, the calibration rule passes, and the point estimates on AH all lines and on the draw-sensitive lines are both positive.
release_with_guardrails.decision: Release with guardrails, as C6 was: recorded as not proven; the current version (v5, C6) kept in shadow on the same inputs; the rollback switch in research_config.json; a rollback trigger in research_monitoring.py matching the existing ones; the home-favourite check in the three holdout leagues; the weekly monitoring.

no_release.conditions: Either point estimate (AH all lines or draw-sensitive lines) is negative or exactly zero, or the calibration rule fails, or the sample minimum is not met.
no_release.decision: No release. Nothing live changes; the report is saved; no shadow run.

outcome_reading: The three outcomes are read in this order and cover every case: no_release first, then proven, otherwise release_with_guardrails. Two points Paul's wording left open are fixed here before scoring. (1) If AH all lines were clear of zero but the draw-sensitive point estimate were negative, the outcome is no_release ('either point estimate negative: no release' takes precedence over 'proven'). (2) A point estimate of exactly zero counts as not positive. The harness's passes_holdout_gate is its standing log-loss-superiority verdict (sample minimum, AH all interval clear of zero, calibration); the outcome above is read from the same verdict's numbers by scripts/c8_holdout_outcome.py, committed with this declaration.
reported_only: 1X2 and Over 1.5 log loss; C8 against M (C8 counts as beating the market only if it beats M by more than the measured Bet365-Pinnacle gap); the calibration slopes and bands themselves; the holdout fixtures C8 does not forecast (no Elo difference).
known_before_scoring: C6's holdout result (scored once on 11 Nov 2026 against C: home / away slopes 0.79 / 1.01, AH all C minus C6 +0.00068), so the relative slope bar is known in advance: a C8 home slope outside 0.90-1.10 passes only if it is within 0.21 of 1, and the away slope must be inside 0.90-1.10 in practice. C8 on development (C6 minus C8 AH all +0.00400, +0.00183 to +0.00646; slopes 1.05 / 1.09), validation (+0.00303, -0.00164 to +0.00746; slopes 1.19 / 1.24, fails v3 against C6) and the retrospective period (+0.00338, -0.00058 to +0.00732; slopes 1.08 / 1.08). Nothing of C8 on the holdout.
setup: Decided by Paul on 17 Nov 2026 (Prompt 5): C8 against C6, AH all lines primary, draw-sensitive lines, calibration v2 with the relative slope rule (v3), the three outcomes above, no forward waiting and no live shadow period before release. C8 was chosen on 16 Nov 2026 (PR #183); Prompt 4 (PR #185, 17 Nov 2026) tested a larger penalty and a season carry-over and changed nothing. Nothing is tuned on the holdout. The ledger holds C6 (candidate, 11 Nov 2026) and D (candidate, 12 Nov 2026); C8 has not been scored.
declared_by: Paul (decision, 17 Nov 2026), written by Claude Code
notes: Scored once with evaluation_harness.py --declaration. No rerun, no change to the setup after it. The holdout decides: there is no forward waiting and no live shadow period before a release. A release still needs the parity test, the replay over the saved live forecasts and a reviewed PR.
